problem_text:
A logistics coordinator needs to assign packages to identical delivery trucks.  
Packages:  
* Package 1: size 45 cubic feet  
* Package 2: size 30 cubic feet  
* Package 3: size 53 cubic feet

* Package 23: size 68 cubic feet

* Package 26: size 55 cubic feet  
* Package 27: size 33 cubic feet  
* Package 28: size 49 cubic feet  
* Package 29: size 41 cubic feet  
* Package 30: size 40 cubic feet  
* Package 31: size 50 cubic feet  
* Package 32: size 37 cubic feet  
* Package 33: size 62 cubic feet  

Each truck can carry up to 100 cubic feet of cargo. Assign all packages using the fewest trucks. Every package must be placed in exactly one truck, and the total cargo volume in a truck cannot exceed its capacity.
